guard.negative_proof: Build, make a commit, run local Playwright: the run is refused with 'dist/ was built from <x>, HEAD is <y>: run pnpm build'.

reuse_boundary: Local development only. CI builds fresh, so the check is a no-op there (guarded by !process.env.CI).
root_cause: Local Playwright runs served dist/ via `astro preview` with no check that dist/ matched HEAD. A stale build produced failures unrelated to the working tree.
rule: Local Playwright runs only against a dist/ built from the current HEAD. A build stamp (dist/.build-commit) is compared to `git rev-parse HEAD` in a local-only globalSetup; mismatch refuses the run.
title: Local Playwright must refuse a stale dist/ build
trigger: 2026-10-16: local e2e was falsely red twice on a stale dist/ (built from an older HEAD than the working tree).
